description: Read a page as Markdown. Use when a task needs the readable text of one web page instead of its HTML: an article, a documentation page, a changelog or a product page, returned as Markdown with its headings, lists, tables and code blocks intact, plus the page's title, byline, language and links. Cost: 1 credit per call.

include_images.description: Return the page's images as a list. Off by default.

include_links.description: Return the page's links as a list. On by default.

max_chars.description: Cap on the Markdown returned, from 1,000 to 200,000 characters. Defaults to 50,000.

url.description: The public http(s) page to read.

name: url_markdown
